summary: Iteration 2 — all 8 backend tests PASS (100%) and all frontend flows verified (100%). Both critical items from iter 1 are fixed: (1) /api/voice/transcribe now returns 200 with {text:''} for a 1s silent WAV (file-handle fix confirmed), (2) /api/scan-card returns coherent JustTCG price data with language field populated. Pikachu Base 58 image identified as english Pikachu with price_source starting 'JustTCG · pokemon', low<=market<=high, mid within range. Non-card 1x1 png returns identified=false with reasoning. Voice chat with card_context returns non-empty reply + audio_base64 + mime='audio/mpeg'. History returns list w/o _id and DELETE clears it. Frontend: Scanner tab shows camera preview (green web placeholder), HOLD MIC TO ASK pill, mic-hold-btn, Awaiting Card empty state. Settings tab shows 'JustTCG (EN + JP)' as Price source. History tab shows persisted scans (Hisuian Lilligant, Vileplume) with prices. Non-blocking: RN-Web deprecation warnings for shadow* and props.pointerEvents persist (already flagged iter 1).

react_native_issues.issue: RN-Web console warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:680-683. props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:249,272,312. Non-blocking on native but noisy on web.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate `shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowOffset/shadowRadius` on styles.micBtn to `boxShadow` for RN-Web compat, and move `pointerEvents="box-none"/"none"` from JSX props to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` in index.tsx (lines 249, 272, 312). Warnings only — safe to ignore for native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/voice/transcribe correctly uses `with open(tmp_path,'rb') as fh: stt.transcribe(file=fh, ...)` (line 409-410) — bug fixed.
server.py fetch_price_and_meta correctly falls back between game='pokemon' and 'pokemon-japan' and ranks candidates by name/number/set match (lines 234-264). Solid.
server.py _best_variant_price picks Near Mint > holofoil variant and derives low/mid/high from 30d stats with a market fallback (lines 151-191). Coherent ordering verified in test_scan_pikachu.
CardInfo.language field wired end-to-end: vision returns 'english'/'japanese'/'other' -> scan_card sets info.language -> frontend index.tsx renders JP chip when language !== 'english'.
server.py /api/scan-card inserts with own uuid _id and /api/history uses projection {_id:0}. No ObjectId leak — verified in test_history_and_clear.
server.py routes all under /api prefix, env-driven via os.environ[...] with no defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME — fails fast if unset. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (scanner/history/settings render + JustTCG label present + testIDs verified)

seed_data_creation: test_scan_pikachu inserted a Pikachu scan; test_history_and_clear ran DELETE /api/history to purge. History tab observed later contained new scans (Hisuian Lilligant, Vileplume) from ongoing camera-preview auto-scans; no residual test data leaked.

rca_of_issue: Iter 1 root causes both fixed: (1) STT accepted str path — now passes an open file handle via context manager. (2) Vision returned wrong Pokemon on JP cards — new prompt requires official English name translation (ウリムー->Swinub, ピカチュウ->Pikachu) with artwork sanity-check and confidence gating. JustTCG lookup then queries 'pokemon' or 'pokemon-japan' by language with cross-game fallback and set/number ranking.
